verdict.rationale: This story asks a product to expose a user's cap table as programmatically accessible equity data, which is the role of an equity-management or data-room platform. Claude is an AI assistant and agent: it would be the client pulling that data, not the system holding it, so the axis is a category error. The generic claim about connecting Claude to tools and data sources is client-side and does not show Claude itself provides cap-table data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
